60110-harper-s-round-table-december-15-1.title: Harper S Round Table December 15 1896
60110-harper-s-round-table-december-15-1.creator: Unknown
60110-harper-s-round-table-december-15-1.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. And yet when they came, strange to say, he seemed to have lost his interest in them. His mother brought them in joyously, but there was not even a glad smile on the lad's face. He looked at them gravely, weighed them in his hands, laid them across the foot of the bed, and then turned his head on his pillow, as if he wanted to go to sleep.

72338-the-right-side-of-the-tracks.title: The Right Side Of The Tracks
72338-the-right-side-of-the-tracks.creator: Unknown
72338-the-right-side-of-the-tracks.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. painful set of alternatives: either an alien species, commencing the building of an empire, had seized the planet; _or_ the Nodarians, turned primitive for some unknown reason, were hiding behind the wall of silence to mount their own attack on the rest of the human universe.

arxiv-2007-06576.title: Brackett- γ \gamma as a Gold-Standard Test of Star Formation Rates Derived from SED-Fitting
arxiv-2007-06576.creator: Imad Pasha, Joel Leja, Pieter G. van Dokkum, Charlie Conroy, Benjamin D. Johnson
arxiv-2007-06576.description: Abstract Using a local reference sample of 21 galaxies, we compare observations of the λ \lambda 2.16 μ \mu m Brackett- γ \gamma (Br γ \gamma ) hydrogen recombination line with predictions from the Prospector Bayesian inference framework, which was used to fit the broadband photometry of these systems.

arxiv-2009-05809.title: Anomalous thermodynamics of a quantum spin system with large residual entropy
arxiv-2009-05809.creator: J. Richter ? , ?, J. Schulenburg ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, D.V. Dmitriev ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, V.Ya. Krivnov ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, J. Schnack ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}
arxiv-2009-05809.description: Abstract In contrast to strongly frustrated classical systems, their quantum counterparts typically have a non-degenerate ground state. A counterexample is the celebrated Heisenberg sawtooth spin chain with ferromagnetic zigzag bonds J 1 J_{1} and competing antiferromagnetic basal bonds J 2 J_{2} .

arxiv-2101-05080.title: Exoplanet Imaging Data Challenge: benchmarking the various image processing methods for exoplanet detection
arxiv-2101-05080.creator: Cantalloube F, Gomez-Gonzalez C, Absil O, Cantero C, Bacher R, Bonse J. M, Bottom M, Dahlqvist C.-H, Desgrange C, Flasseur O, Fuhrmann T, Henning Th, Jensen-Clem R, Kenworthy M, Mawet D, Mesa D, Meshkat T, Mouillet D, Müller A, Nasedkin E, Pairet B, Pierard S, Ruffio J.-B, Samland M, Stone J, Van Dr
arxiv-2101-05080.description: Abstract The Exoplanet Imaging Data Challenge is a community-wide effort meant to offer a platform for a fair and common comparison of image processing methods designed for exoplanet direct detection. For this purpose, it gathers on a dedicated repository (Zenodo), data from several high-contrast ground-based instruments worldwide in which we injected synthetic planetary signals.

arxiv-2205-08655.title: Carrier-envelope-phase and helicity control of electron vortices in photodetachment
arxiv-2205-08655.creator: M. M. Majczak, F. Cajiao Vélez, J. Z. Kamiński, K. Krajewska
arxiv-2205-08655.description: Abstract Formation of electron vortices and momentum spirals in photodetachment of the H - anion driven by isolated ultrashort laser pulses of circular polarization or by pairs of such pulses (of either corotating or counterrotating polarizations) are analyzed under the scope of the strong-field approximation.

arxiv-2206-00942.title: A Serverless Engine for High Energy Physics Distributed Analysis
arxiv-2206-00942.creator: 1 st Jacek Kuśnierz, 2 nd Vincenzo E. Padulano, 3 rd Maciej Malawski, 4 th Kamil Burkiewicz, 5 th Enric Tejedor Saavedra, 6 th Pedro Alonso-Jordá, 7 th Michael Pitt, 8 th Valentina Avati
arxiv-2206-00942.description: Abstract The Large Hadron Collider (LHC) at CERN has generated in the last decade an unprecedented volume of data for the High-Energy Physics (HEP) field. Scientific collaborations interested in analysing such data very often require computing power beyond a single machine. This issue has been tackled traditionally by running analyses in distributed environments using stateful, managed batch computing systems.

arxiv-2210-08671.title: The Kraichnan Model and Non-Equilibrium Statistical Physics of Diffusive Mixing
arxiv-2210-08671.creator: Gregory Eyink, Amir Jafari
arxiv-2210-08671.description: Abstract We discuss application of methods from the Kraichnan model of turbulent advection to the study of non-equilibrium concentration fluctuations arising during diffusion in liquid mixtures at high Schmidt numbers. This approach treats nonlinear advection of concentration fluctuations exactly, without linearization.

arxiv-2301-07398.title: Will ALMA Reveal the True Core Mass Function of Protoclusters? 2022 Will ALMA Reveal the True Core Mass Function of Protoclusters? –
arxiv-2301-07398.creator: P. Padoan, V.-M. Pelkonen, M. Juvela, T. Haugbølle, Å. Nordlund
arxiv-2301-07398.description: Abstract Characterizing prestellar cores in star-forming regions is an important step towards the validation of theoretical models of star formation. Thanks to their sub-arcsecond resolution, ALMA observations can potentially provide samples of prestellar cores up to distances of a few kpc, where regions of massive star formation can be targeted.

arxiv-2303-08335.creator: Qianqian Xie, Jiayu Zhou, Yifan Peng, Fei Wang
arxiv-2303-08335.description: Abstract . Automatic radiology report summarization is a crucial clinical task, whose key challenge is to maintain factual accuracy between produced summaries and ground truth radiology findings. Existing research adopts reinforcement learning to directly optimize factual consistency metrics such as CheXBert or RadGraph score.

arxiv-2312-05550.title: D3A-TS: Denoising-Driven Data Augmentation in Time Series Journal: To decide
arxiv-2312-05550.creator: David Solís-Martín 1,2 Juan Galán-Páez 1,2 and Joaquín Borrego-Díaz 2
arxiv-2312-05550.description: Abstract It has been demonstrated that the amount of data is crucial in data-driven machine learning methods. Data is always valuable, but in some tasks, it is almost like gold. This occurs in engineering areas where data is scarce or very expensive to obtain, such as predictive maintenance, where faults are rare.

arxiv-2407-13783.title: Field Theoretic Renormalization Group in an Infinite-Dimensional Model of Random Surface Growth in Random Environment
arxiv-2407-13783.creator: N V Antonov, A A Babakin, N M Gulitskiy, P I Kakin
arxiv-2407-13783.description: Abstract The influence of a random environment on the dynamics of a fluctuating rough surface is investigated using a field theoretic renormalization group. The environment motion is modelled by the stochastic Navier–Stokes equation, which includes both a fluid in thermal equilibrium and a turbulent fluid. The surface is described by the generalized Pavlik’s stochastic equation.

arxiv-2408-10006.title: Unlocking the Power of LSTM for Long Term Time Series Forecasting
arxiv-2408-10006.creator: Yaxuan Kong, Zepu Wang, Yuqi Nie, Tian Zhou, Stefan Zohren, Yuxuan Liang, Peng Sun, Qingsong Wen
arxiv-2408-10006.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yaxuan Kong, Zepu Wang, Yuqi Nie, Tian Zhou, Stefan Zohren, Yuxuan Liang, Peng Sun, Qingsong Wen. Traditional recurrent neural network architectures, such as long short-term memory neural networks (LSTM), have historically held a prominent role in time series forecasting (TSF) tasks. While the recently introduced sLSTM for Natural Language Processing (NLP) introduces exponential gating and memory mixing that are beneficial for long term sequential learning, its potential short memory issue is a barrier to applying sLSTM directly in TSF.

arxiv-2410-21430.title: Radial properties of dust in galaxies: Comparison between observations and isolated galaxy simulations
arxiv-2410-21430.creator: S.A. van der Giessen, K. Matsumoto, M. Relano, I. De Looze, L. Romano, H. Hirashita, K. Nagamine, M. Baes, M. Palla, K.C. Hou, C. Faesi
arxiv-2410-21430.description: Abstract We study the importance of several processes that influence the evolution of dust and its grain size distribution on spatially resolved scales in nearby galaxies. Here, we compiled several multi-wavelength observations for the nearby galaxies NGC 628 (M74), NGC 5457 (M101), NGC 598 (M33), and NGC 300.

pmc-10811269.creator: Dalal M. Alkuraythi, Manal M. Alkhulaifi, Abdulwahab Z. Binjomah, Mohammed Alarwi, Mohammed I. Mujallad, Saleh Ali Alharbi, Mohammad Alshomrani, Takashi Gojobori, Sulaiman M. Alajel
pmc-10811269.description: IntroductionStaphylococcus aureus is a significant human pathogen that poses a threat to public health due to its association with foodborne contamination and a variety of infections. The factors contributing to the pathogenicity of S. aureus include virulence, drug resistance, and toxin production, making it essential to monitor their prevalence and genetic profiles.

pmc-11518989.title: The non-canonical BAF chromatin remodeling complex is a novel target of spliceosome dysregulation in SF3B1-mutated chronic lymphocytic leukemia
pmc-11518989.creator: Daniel Hägerstrand, Blaž Oder, Diego Cortese, Ying Qu, Amrei Binzer-Panchal, Cecilia Österholm, Teresa Del Peso Santos, Leily Rabbani, Hassan Foroughi Asl, Aron Skaftason, Viktor Ljungström, August Lundholm, Maria Koutroumani, Zahra Haider, Cecilia Jylhä, John Mollstedt, Larry Mansouri, Karla Plevov

To investigate their impact, we conducted RNA-sequencing of 18 SF3B1MUT and 17 SF3B1WT subset #2 cases and identified 80 significant alternative splicing events (ASEs).

pmc-11554620.title: Bronchoalveolar lavage fluid and lung biopsy tissue metagenomic next-generation sequencing in the diagnosis of pulmonary cryptococcosis
pmc-11554620.creator: Jinbao Huang, Heng Weng, Ling Ye, Meiqin Jiang, Lulu Chen, Yangyu Li, Hongyan Li
pmc-11554620.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the diagnostic value of metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) in pulmonary cryptococcosis (PC) using bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) and lung biopsy tissue specimens.MethodsIn this retrospective study, 321 patients diagnosed with lower respiratory tract diseases who underwent mNGS using BALF and LBT samples, between January 2021 and December 2023 were included.

pmc-11631606.title: A case report and literature review: one case of ceftriaxone sodium-induced reversible gallbladder stone
pmc-11631606.creator: Changqin Luo, Qingmin He, Xiaocui Yang
pmc-11631606.description: This paper reports a case of pseudolithiasis caused by the use of ceftriaxone sodium. The patient, a 54-year-old female, presented with intermittent abdominal pain and distension for 1 month. Initial ultrasonography showed no abnormalities. However, after receiving ceftriaxone sodium treatment for an upper respiratory tract infection, she developed discomfort in the right upper abdomen.

pmc-12805323.title: Digital Health Literacy and Its Role in Awareness of and Access to Sexual Health Products and Services Among Displaced Youth in Uganda’s Informal Urban Settlements: Community-Based Cross-Sectional Study

However, there is limited understanding of displaced youth’s digital health literacy (DHL) and its association with knowledge of and access to sexual health products and services.

pmc-13081487.title: The relationship between women’s awareness of sustainable menstrual cups, their menstrual attitudes, and genital hygiene behaviors: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13081487.creator: Aynur Ataman Kufacı, Funda Erol, Tuba Yılmaz Bulut, Hurmus Kuzgun
pmc-13081487.description: BackgroundThe relationship between women’s awareness of menstrual cups, their menstrual attitudes, and their genital hygiene behaviors is emerging as an important research topic in the field of women’s health globally. This study examined the relationship between women’s awareness of menstrual cups as a sustainable menstrual hygiene product, their menstrual attitudes, and their genital hygiene behaviors.
